Bhimtal, Kumaon

Born on these roads, still driving them.

Peak Pilot Travelers started with one Innova and a handful of regulars who needed a driver who wouldn't get nervous on the Rishikesh–Badrinath stretch. Years on, we're still a small, local outfit — but now with a full fleet, a bench of dependable drivers, and routes across every corner of Uttarakhand mapped from experience, not a GPS.

Whether it's a family's first Char Dham Yatra, a couple chasing snow in Auli, or a trekking group headed for the Valley of Flowers, we plan the logistics so you can just be present for the mountains.

Every kind of Himalayan trip, one call away.

From four-temple pilgrimages to honeymoon hideaways, we build the itinerary around you — not the other way round.

Char Dham Yatra

Complete Kedarnath, Badrinath, Gangotri & Yamunotri circuits with fixed halts, pooja arrangements and rest days built in.

Trekking & Camping

Guided treks to Valley of Flowers, Chopta and Kuari Pass, with camping stays under proper Himalayan skies.

Hotel & Resort Booking

Hand-checked stays in Nainital, Mussoorie and Auli — from budget lodges to riverside resorts.

Cab & Taxi Rental

Innovas, Sumos and sedans with drivers who know every hairpin from Rishikesh to the high Himalaya.

Honeymoon Packages

Quiet valley-view stays, candlelight dinners and slow drives through Uttarakhand's prettiest hill towns.

Custom Group Tours

College trips, family reunions or office offsites — tell us the headcount and the vibe, we'll plan the rest.
